verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS product with public APIs, a CLI, and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test tenant, or dry-run mode. Self-hosting on your own Linux server is only a user-side workaround for building a separate environment, not a product-provided sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
